body: It is such a notoriously impeccable feeling that I have about the Universe project right now. There are tons of not working smart, but hard work, sweat, and tears that built this Game Engine and its playing platform across 5 operating systems: Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, and iOS.
Will continue writing about what happened during these past easy-to-say 4.5 years as i grow to be yet better.
